paper_metadata.title: A Novel Active Feedback Flyback With Only 100-mV Inductive Overshoot for a Standard Low-Voltage CMOS Inductive Load Driver, in a Single-Chip Controller for 73 Relays in a POTS/ADSL
paper_metadata.abstract: This paper presents an inductive load driver. The circuit is realized in a standard low-voltage CMOS process: as the coil freewheels when the driver is switched off, the circuit clamps the output voltage at 100 mV above the power supply. Hence, no highvoltage technology or high-voltage tolerant circuit is required. 73 drivers are integrated in an ASIC, controlling 73 relays for a test access function on a POTS/ADSL splitter filter board.
